falsification_conditions.condition: The asset's price breaks above the $150 resistance level with a 5% increase over 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A clear bullish breakout would invalidate the 'HOLD' signal by demonstrating a confirmed trend reversal

falsification_conditions.condition: Trading volume exceeds 200% of the 30-day average volume for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained extreme volume would indicate strong market participation contradicting the 'UNKNOWN' phase assumption of indecision

falsification_conditions.condition: The Federal Reserve announces a 50-basis point rate cut instead of the expected 25-basis point cut
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This specific macroeconomic event would directly contradict the pattern's blowoff score and invalidate the current verdict

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
